R461.note: ECB replaced with CBC + random IV; prepending IV to ciphertext is a necessary, plainly-stated format change.

R462.note: Structured FTPClient API correctly replaces raw command concatenation, but silently swaps the inert literal password placeholder for a real System.getenv() lookup, an undisclosed behavior change beyond the injection fix.

R463.note: ObjectInputFilter allowlist blocks arbitrary classes, but pattern "evalcases.OrderEvent;!*" also rejects every class OrderEvent's own fields reference (String, etc.), risking InvalidClassException on legitimate messages; not addressed.

R464.note: JSON.parse + Ajv schema correctly replaces node-serialize; the property allowlist and empty-object fallback are disclosed.

R465.note: CRLF rejection on both envelope fields correctly closes the SMTP command injection.

R466.note: Straightforward parameterized SqlCommand fix, behavior preserved.

R467.note: strnlen bounded to sizeof(name) eliminates the overread; behavior differs only in the previously-undefined unterminated case.

R468.note: Drops the format()-as-format-string sink for HTML-encoded println; benign inputs unaffected and a latent format-string crash is incidentally fixed.

R469.note: json_encode is correct for JS-string context; PHP's default slash-escaping also blocks a </script> breakout.

R470.note: secrets-based token generation is a correct CSPRNG fix; the format/length change is explicitly disclosed with an alternative given.

R471.note: Content-sniffed allowlist, random filename, and storage outside webroot together close CWE-434; the behavior changes are inherent to and disclosed as part of the remediation.

R472.note: crypto/rand.Int with big.Int avoids modulo bias; the added error path is a disclosed, appropriate robustness change.

R473.note: Same-origin check via URI.isAbsolute() misses protocol-relative "//evil.com" URLs (no scheme, so isAbsolute() is false) - a well-known open-redirect bypass left unaddressed.

R474.note: Same correct CBC/random-IV pattern as the C# ECB case; the format change is disclosed.

R475.note: Correct mysqli prepared-statement fix, behavior preserved.

R476.note: Primary "Fix" hardcodes a fictitious someStoredProc procedure and repurposes param as its argument, discarding the original dynamic-procedure-selection behavior; the actually-correct allowlist approach is relegated to a secondary "alternative" note.

R477.note: Correctly checks verify()'s boolean return before trusting claims.

R478.note: offset + length > frame.size() can integer-overflow (wrap past SIZE_MAX) when length is huge, silently bypassing the very check it adds; explanation's "cannot wrap below zero" claim is true but misses the actual wraparound direction.

R479.note: Same correct encode-at-sink fix pattern as the sibling XSS case.

R480.note: Allowlist correctly preserves dynamic procedure selection while closing the injection; placeholder names are clearly illustrative.

R481.note: Delegating to Jakarta Mail's InternetAddress/Transport correctly closes the CRLF injection, but adds an undisclosed hard STARTTLS requirement that could break sending against a relay without STARTTLS, and cites an unverifiable CVE number.

R482.note: Correct output-encoding fix applied at the actual HTML sink.

R483.note: Deletes the Entity assignment but leaves the now-unused `label` variable declared earlier in the function, which fails to compile in Go ("declared and not used") since that line isn't also removed.

R484.note: Verified by compiling: the raw control-byte case labels are legal Java and the escape table is complete/correct; SLF4J's trailing-Throwable convention still logs the exception.

R485.note: The non-Windows branch is properly fixed by invoking /bin/ls directly, but the Windows branch still launches cmd.exe /c as FileName, so cmd.exe itself re-parses the command line and can still interpret shell metacharacters in data despite the array form.

R486.note: Removing mark_safe() causes Django's default autoescape to escape the entire returned string, including the intended <div class='announcement'> wrapper markup, breaking the banner's rendering for every legitimate announcement - contrary to the write-up's explicit (incorrect) claim that the wrapper is preserved.

R487.note: Correct PreparedStatement fix; resource cleanup updated consistently.

R488.note: Imports escape_filter_chars from ldap3.utils.dn, but that function actually lives in ldap3.utils.conv - ldap3.utils.dn has no such name, so this raises ImportError and the endpoint never runs.

R489.note: Swapping text/template for html/template is the correct, minimal, standard fix.

R490.note: html.escape() applied at each interpolation point correctly closes the XSS.

R492.note: Removing the CSRF exemption restores Spring Security's default protection; the now-required CSRF token on billing requests is the intended, disclosed effect.

R493.note: Removing cmd.exe as FileName eliminates the shell that reinterprets metacharacters, closing the reported CWE-78 vector; primary snippet still concatenates Arguments as one string (residual flag/argument-injection risk, fully closed only in the noted ArgumentList alternative).

R494.note: use CGI::Util qw(html_escape) - CGI::Util exports no such function (it has escape/unescape for URL encoding, not HTML escaping); this is a fatal "not exported" compile-time error in Perl, failing every request.

R495.note: isAllowedRedirect returns true immediately for any string starting with "/", so a protocol-relative URL like "//evil.com/x" (classic open-redirect bypass) is treated as trusted with no host check at all.

R496.note: Correctly replaces the token-controlled jku with a hardcoded trusted JWKS URL.

R497.note: Textbook-correct ordering - sign check, then offset<=len, then length<=len-offset - avoids both the signedness and subtraction-underflow bugs.

R498.note: Allowlist substitution for the ORDER BY identifier is the correct shape; the silent fallback to a default sort for unrecognized values is disclosed.

R499.note: AES-256-GCM correctly replaces DES-CBC-zero-IV, but the new key handling silently zero-pads or truncates the raw form value to 32 bytes instead of validating length or deriving via a KDF, quietly weakening key material versus the original's strict-length requirement.

R500.note: calloc's built-in overflow check is the standard, correct fix; behavior unaffected since the loop overwrites every element regardless of calloc's zero-init.
